From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity pricing, GPU profile & throughput next steps

Hi Anna / Matt —

Thanks again for the product deep-dive today. Quick written recap and three concrete next steps so we have alignment before I put together pricing scenarios.

Call recap (short):
- Workload: user-facing summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for docs and chat. Typical prompt length ~1.5k tokens; average response ~900 tokens.
- Volume: you estimated 600–900M tokens/month steady state over Q3; growth runway to ~1.5B in 12 months.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for common prompts; some relaxed offline batch jobs ok.
- Availability: multi-AZ preferred; can accept regional (us-west) Dedicated deployment.
- Model preference: leaning toward a 70B dense open model (quantization acceptable), customer asked about H100 vs A100 tradeoffs.

Key pricing/qualification items we discussed and what I need to finalize options:
1) Target unit economics: you mentioned a goal of ~$40–60 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens). Confirmed?
2) Commitment window: do you prefer 12 vs 24 month reserved capacity? 24mo reduces unit price materially.
3) Throughput targets: can you confirm peak concurrent inference requests and typical tokens/sec at peak? I have a conservative estimate framed below but want your numbers.

Preliminary sizing assumptions I will run with unless you correct me:
- Working model: 70B dense quantized (post-quantization path)
- GPU profile options: H100 80GB (best perf per GPU for large batches), A100 80GB (cost-effective), or mixed pool with H100 for peak-routing and A100 for steady state.
- Example reserved cluster sizes to support 600–900M tokens/month: 4x A100 (steady) or 2x H100 + 2x A100 (hybrid).
- Estimated reserved spend (ballpark, final quote to follow): $45k–90k/month depending on GPU mix and commitment term. This maps to ~ $30–70/1M tokens in our throughput/usage simulations.

Three immediate next steps (action items):
- Anna: confirm exact monthly token volume target (conservative baseline + growth plan) and whether $40–60/1M is a hard target or a negotiation band.
- Rishi (me): produce 3 pricing scenarios (A100-only, H100-only, hybrid) with committed monthly cost, projected $/1M tokens, and throughput headroom — will include a short ops note on queuing/latency tradeoffs. Attachment: prelim-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (draft).
- Schedule a procurement + security call to review SOW and compliance asks; I'll attach a preliminary SOW link for signatures.

I'll aim to get the scenarios to you by EOD Thursday (2026-03-25) so we can sync before your exec review next week.

Thanks — Rishi

--

Thanks Rishi — this is a helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed monthly target: baseline 800M tokens/month for Q3 (that should be the committed minimum). We expect a 20–40% month-over-month growth on top for the first 3 months after launch; plan capacity accordingly.
- Peak behavior: concurrent interactive sessions up to 60 concurrent users at peak; typical peak TPS ~180 tokens/sec aggregate (based on our front-end batching).
- Latency: p95 target 200–250ms for 1.5k token prompts; we understand there are tradeoffs at scale.
- GPU preference: engineering prefers H100 for headroom on long-context and KV cache, but procurement is price-sensitive — they asked for a 12mo commitment quote first and a 24mo option if that drops cost substantially.
- Budget guardrail: at this stage finance is looking for committed spend not to exceed $95k/month on infra (not counting professional services). If a configuration requires more, call it out so we can evaluate.

Matt (cc) will be the procurement lead; loop him into SOW/procurement items.

Anna

Thanks for the clarifications — that's exactly what we needed. Attached is the first-pass pricing scenarios (prelim-pricing-scenarios.xlsx) and a short operations note (throughput-ops-reqs.pdf). Summary highlights below: 

1) Scenarios (12mo / 24mo):
- A100-only (4x A100 80GB reserved): $52k/mo (12mo) | $45k/mo (24mo) — projected $/1M tokens ≈ $42 (at 800M tokens).
- H100-only (2x H100 80GB reserved): $78k/mo (12mo) | $66k/mo (24mo) — projected $/1M tokens ≈ $70 (at 800M tokens), but substantially better p95 for long prompts and higher headroom for bursts.
- Hybrid (2x H100 + 2x A100): $65k/mo (12mo) | $56k/mo (24mo) — projected $/1M tokens ≈ $55 (at 800M tokens). Hybrid gives best balance for latency and cost.

Notes on assumptions: token model: 70B dense, quantized execution path for A100; H100 assumed for larger KV cache and batched throughput. Token accounting uses production center-of-traffic on us-west region and includes prefix/KV cache hit rates we discussed (assumed 12% effective caching).

2) SLA / throughput: All scenarios assume autoscaling burst capacity for short spikes (billed as overage). For your peak TPS (~180 tokens/sec) the A100-only cluster should meet latency SLO for most prompts but will have less headroom for simultaneous long-context prompts; H100 or hybrid is recommended if consistent p95 <250ms is non-negotiable.

3) Budget fit: 12mo A100-only at $52k/mo meets your $95k/month guardrail by a wide margin; H100-only 12mo at $78k/mo also fits. If you want target unit economics ~$40/1M tokens, A100-only 24mo gets you closest.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement call to review SOW + finalize commitment term (Anna / Matt). I'll include a DocuSign-ready SOW link.
- Technical sync with our infra lead (cc Marissa) to validate peak workload tests and map KV-cache hit expectations into sizing.

Links / attachments: prelim-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (attached) | throughput-ops-reqs.pdf (attached) | SOW_prelim_docu_sign_link.txt (DocuSign link)

Can we schedule the procurement call for Thursday 03/26 or Friday 03/27? I have availability 09:00–12:00 PT on both days.

-Rishi
